{{Top|leg}}
The '''Suolriep Sector Group''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Group]] assigned to the defense of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. As a young [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was assigned to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pter Nyklas]]'s [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Flanchard]]'' that patrolled the Suolriep sector.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
